the Holy One, … Blessed be He, … said to Moses:
the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to Moses:
taught only with regard to two … types of death … But … does judge … of one type of death,

taught only with regard to two different types of death imposed by a court, as each case needs sufficient time to be fully investigated on its own merits. But the court does judge multiple cases of one type of death,

p: on which the … charity [tzedaka] is left overnight,
on which the distribution of charity [tzedaka] is left overnight,
As it is stated: “She that was full of justice [tzedek],
but with regard to the delaying of the distribution of money,
how should we act? If we say that we
judge him on Shabbat eve and conclude his verdict on Shabbat eve,
perhaps we would see a reason to find … liable, … and … required to perform a suspension of the trial … We … judge him on Shabbat eve and conclude

perhaps we would see a reason to find the accused liable, and in this situation the court is required to perform a suspension of the trial until the following day, as the court may not issue a verdict in cases of capital law on the same day as the deliberations. If we say: We should judge him on Shabbat eve and conclude
And … We … kill him at night, … we require … facing the sun,
And if we say: We should kill him at night, after the conclusion of Shabbat, that cannot be done, as we require that the capital punishment be administered facing the sun,
